The dataset metadata says MIT, but the dataset card also says the text was dumped from jeja.pl community submissions, so do not describe it as public-domain-clean.

new-memes-pl-superadmin.note: Polish meme cards reuse the image/photo composition from pack:new-memes-ru-superadmin and redraw detected caption areas with machine translated ru->pl text. This does not create a new rights claim for the underlying meme/photo material.
rules: Keep this pack tied to the same rights and safety assumptions as pack:new-memes-ru-superadmin.
Do not describe these cards as public-domain-clean.
Review machine translations before broad queue use when wording quality matters.

psychology-ru-superadmin.note: Original concise psychology card text and independent local templates generated for this project; no external quote/photo corpus and no MGS template inheritance is intentionally used.
rules: Do not use MGS packs/templates as a donor or fallback for this super-admin pack.
Do not use real/identifiable faces; generic abstract silhouettes are allowed only outside the main text area.
Avoid medical diagnosis, crisis advice, manipulative promises, or protected-class targeting.
Keep as general self-reflection/behavioral prompts, not therapy replacement.

motivation-en-superadmin.note: English motivation cards use original project-written list text, OpenAI-generated cinematic backgrounds, and local ffmpeg-synth audio beds.
rules: No copied quotes or real-person attribution without a separate source ledger.
No social handles, channel plaques, logos, AP/news imagery, gender hostility, protected-class insults, politics, sexual content, violence, medical claims, or guaranteed success promises.
Keep text short and mobile-readable.
